summary: @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk: static keyword co-occurrence in bundled dist, no corroborated installer harm
details: The package ships a large bundled dist/index.js containing multiple POST call sites and a 'dyndns' token match. The matches are keyword co-occurrences within a bundled SDK and no specific attacker-controlled destination, credential read, lifecycle-script execution, or install-time network behavior has been identified from the package contents. The scope (@magda) corresponds to the Magda open-data platform and the package is published as a prerelease SDK whose purpose is to index content for that platform, which is consistent with the presence of HTTP POST calls to configured service endpoints. No install, preinstall, postinstall, or prepare lifecycle scripts fetch or execute remote code, and no reads of installer secrets (environment variables, ~/.npmrc, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws) are present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
